span.p: 运营审核操作

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 更新 PG 状态为 DISCARDED

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
1. 开启 PG 事务:
保存答案草稿，递增 version
计算确定性主键 chunk_id = sha256(queue_id + ':' + version)
状态置为 PUBLISHING 并提交 PG

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. 调用 EcomRAG 内部发布接口:
POST /internal/v1/kb/upsert (携带确定性 chunk_id)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
EcomRAG 调用 BGE-M3 生成向量
按主键 chunk_id 执行 Milvus Upsert (天然幂等覆盖)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Milvus Upsert 是否成功?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. 回写 PG 状态为 PUBLISHED
C 端与 B 端检索立即同步生效!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. 回写 PG 状态为 PUBLISH_FAILED (记录错误原因)
支持运营一键重试或定时重试 (相同 chunk_id 绝不产生重复向量)
